summary: Five HUD-root routines reconstructed as bounded selection, row-update and closed-row host contracts. These routines do not write the medal widgets.
reconstruction_scope: Whole seed control policies expressed through mandatory host interfaces; supporting native callees, NativeString allocator/SEH paths and exact x87 execution are not implemented. This is a partial native reconstruction, not five complete native replacements.

routines.behavior: Initialize discriminator zero/index FFFFh; map members to group leader through 007788B0/007788D0; primary pointer equality search; native signed BX index tests. Byte +1 padding is omitted.
Leaders take primary lookup; only members are searched in the secondary list. A found secondary member sets discriminator only for count > 1.

routines.native_abi: ECX=root; one unused four-byte stack argument; RET 4
routines.behavior: Poll 8D,8C,8E,8F; suppression gate; next before previous; primary before secondary; primary and secondary word-index wrap rules; secondary zero maps to primary; pending byte is set but never cleared.

routines.native_abi: ECX=root; no stack arguments; RET; native SEH and string temporary cleanup outside projection
routines.behavior: Rebuild lists; choose controlled/selected/override unit; weapon-source recipe and animation policy; command descriptor state; name and controlled-country flags; computed payload state; health-width policy and cache; final weapon hide gate.

routines.native_abi: ECX=root; no stack arguments; RET; native caller guarantees required controlled unit/member
routines.behavior: Exactly-zero closed state conditionally switches 22h/23h using first-member payload; exactly-one clears flag and optionally restores saved interface/payload; other state values unchanged.
